selfPortrait.tagline: Selected work, 2019–present. Five pieces. Scroll to walk through them.

projects.title: Wave
projects.description: An AI tool that turns recorded conversation into searchable memory. Designed the core chat experience, brand system, and interface end to end.

projects.title: CyberKongz
projects.description: A mobile app for a Web3 gaming ecosystem — 2D/3D avatars, a utility token, a metaverse layer. Designed the full mobile experience.
projects.proof: Best UX, Best UI, Best Innovation — CSS Design Awards 2023.

projects.title: Touchbiz
projects.meta: Product Design, Design Systems · Sixty Two
projects.description: A digital banking platform for Indonesian SMEs — loans, transfers, and multi-level approvals made legible. Owned the UI design and design system for the mobile app; UX and IA direction led by a senior designer.
projects.proof: Design system scaled across both individual and business account types.

projects.title: Ballogy
projects.description: A 300K+ user sports app rebuilt around three distinct roles — player, coach, parent — instead of one generic experience. Directed the UI visual direction and the high-level UX: information architecture and flow. Interface execution shared with a fellow senior designer.

projects.title: Mantis
projects.description: A liquid-handling instrument for life-science labs, used by Pfizer and Synlab. Interface designed to turn dense scientific data into guided, error-proof workflows.
projects.proof: Unit sales grew from 132 to 381 over two years.

bio.name: Fadhil Yassar
paragraphs: Product Designer, currently remote. Open to relocating within Europe for the right opportunity, with visa sponsorship.
Trained in nuclear engineering before moving into design. Been building digital products since 2019, mostly for domains with real constraints: banking, AI tools, medical hardware.
